If you swing it at an enemy's shield, it may be able to knock the shield out of your foe's hand.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 6 |durability = 12 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Boko Bat}} Boko Bats are clubs found across [[Hyrule Kingdom]], particularly in the hands of [[Bokoblin]]s and [[Moblin]]s in [[Hyrule Field]] and [[West Necluda]]. They also have a chance of appearing in [[Treasure Chest]]s that appear when the {{BotW|-}} Series Bokoblin [[amiibo]] is scanned using the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Bokoblins create these [[Weapon]]s, making them part of the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} They are clunky and able to knock the [[Shield]]s out of an [[Enemy]]'s hands. Since they are made of wood, Boko Bats burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They also float if they dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. While this means they do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, they also are not able to be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_004" |Life = 8 |Power = 6 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 2 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 3 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 5 |BuyingPrice = 9 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Two-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Boko Bat Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Boko Bat ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bokoblin Gear * Dragonbone Boko Bat * Spiked Boko Bat * Sturdy Thick Stick * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bokoblin Gear, Clubs, Weapons, Two-Handed Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
